runner_and_process_pitfalls: Parenthesize each Test-Path expression before combining with -or in PowerShell.
When auditing Win32_Process command lines, exclude the auditing PowerShell's own $PID; its command line contains the run root and caused two false positives.

Do not decide liveness from a historical numeric PID alone; Windows may reuse it. Match PID with process name, command line and creation identity. At final audit, historical numbers 34332 and 10652 belonged to unrelated WebView/RuntimeBroker processes.

Use a persistent hidden Start-Process launcher with durable stdout/stderr, a fresh output root and recorded child PID/arguments/hashes. A direct outer tool timeout can detach or close stdout while the child continues.

Do not interpret runner exit code alone. Owner FAIL intentionally ends with a nonzero diagnostic gate even when post-clean, exact restore and normal resume pass; read stage-run/restore/normal artifacts.
Normalize timestamps, PIDs and fixed verifier cache paths before hashing stable artifacts.
Prompt timeout is 900 s; every wait must remain bounded and fail closed.
The R9 telemetry file is a fixed 65536-byte ring. The qualification parser is an initial-gate snapshot; final monitor-result is authoritative for total loop_records_seen and last_iteration.
Long functions.exec/shell sessions must be waited to terminal completion; never leave runner, monitor, supervisor, prompt or programmer processes alive.
Reject output-directory reuse, consumed authorization reuse, hash drift, simulation injection in Execute, child nonzero without disposition, and any automatic retry.
Routine cleanup/recovery/fault paths must never open a popup.
